verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a substantial programmatic surface. It has a localhost API bundled with the desktop app, a headless CLI server, an official MCP server, and an agents toolkit that can read, search and modify Objects. It also exposes chat endpoints, a versioned OpenAPI spec (v2 pre-release, objects as editable JSON), and a gRPC API on the core. However, nothing documents or claims parity with the UI, and many UI features have no evidenced API coverage. missing for 10: any stated UI–API parity guarantee; API coverage for publishing, templates, queries/views, graph, sharing/collaboration invites, import/export, and widgets/sidebar; independent hands-on corroboration; a stable (non-pre-release) v2.
